Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1599) Oct 15, 2026

  • Fixed: a cut opened with the last cut’s shot names. A cut Pull Plates hadn’t seen before took the previous cut’s names and sequence, so its plates on disk weren’t found and every shot read New. In the pipeline’s folders it now takes the names its plates on disk were pulled under; a cut with its own settings is told, with a button, when its plates are under another sequence.
  • Fixed: the list of names a pull has given is kept in each sequence’s own folder, so one sequence’s names no longer reach another.
  • Fixing orphaned plates. Each folder in the Orphans row’s Show menu now has its own tools, used one folder at a time, each saying what it will do before it does it.
  • Identify… finds where an orphan’s frames sit in the cut by their timecode: each event whose Source TC they hold, where the cut’s first frame lands on the plate, the handles each end, and the plate’s frame beside the cut’s picture of the same source frame. It writes nothing.
  • Adopt… adds the orphan’s line to its shot’s source_info.txt, with who adopted it and when, so it is a pipeline plate from then on.
  • Set Aside… moves the orphan’s version folder, whole, to the job’s 00_ADMIN/_OMITTED, with a record of the move, so its shot can be pulled. Nothing is deleted.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1476) Oct 12, 2026

  • DPX sequences play. 8, 10, 12 and 16-bit DPX files open and play like any other image sequence, read as the color space set for DPX in Settings, Color.
  • A tall floating Playlist with thumbnails could stop the app. Fixed.
  • Small fixes.

1.0 (build 1441) Oct 11, 2026

  • Network is in the Review menu. Review ▸ Network; it was under Window. It is also in the right-click Review menu.
  • A playlist on a network drive no longer slows the window. Whether each clip's file is there is checked in the background.
  • Locate Media… reads a folder in the background. A line above the toolbar says how far it has got.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1596) Oct 15, 2026

  • Updated edits over vfx edit’s shots. In the pipeline’s folders, Pull Plates now reads the shots vfx edit commit published (from each shot’s source_info.txt) as well as Asobi’s own. A shot whose clip is already there keeps its number, a new shot takes a number between its neighbors, and a plate that is all on disk is left alone. An updated plate is the next version beside vfx edit’s, never written into it.
  • A take used twice. A pop-up beside Pull only what changed chooses how two shots of one take are told apart: by the frames each uses, or in clip order as vfx edit compare does.
  • Orphaned plates. Plate folders that no pipeline tool accounts for get a warning, with each folder to show in the Finder. Their shot is held until they are moved out; nothing is matched to them or written beside them.
  • A shot with no plates yet (made by mkshot or vfx edit) keeps its number from new shots.
  • Fixed: pulling one sequence counted every other sequence’s shots as no longer in the cut, in the Pulled before row, the ingest CSV’s OMITTED rows and Kitsu’s Cut column. Only the pull’s own shots count now.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1593) Oct 14, 2026

  • Any window starts tabs. Click + at the right of a floating window’s title bar and pick another open window: the two become tabs of one window. Have as many groups as you like.
  • Drag to combine, reorder and take out. Drag a window by its title bar onto another’s tabs or title bar to join it; drag a tab sideways to reorder it, or down off the strip to make it a window again.
  • Scroll arrows. When a group’s tabs don’t fit, ‹ and › at the ends step through them. A group is never narrower than its widest window needs.
  • Tabs with news. A Pull Plates or Queue tab behind another shows a dot when a pull ends: green finished, amber frames to check, red a plate failed.
  • Notes in a window. The arrow in the notes list’s header puts the notes in a window of their own, which can be a tab; close it and they are back beside the picture.
